resolutions.candidate: Long Service and Good Conduct Medal, for Prison
resolutions.basis: The source object is the prison-ribbon counterpart of the already normalized police and army Long and Distinguished Service / Long Service and Good Conduct series; complete front and reverse are present.

The retained complete object is bronze and its green ribbon has the three white longitudinal lines specified for Class III; the official description distinguishes Class I gilt silver/seven lines, Class II silver/five lines and Class III bronze/three lines.

evidence.summary: Complete bronze Duty Medal with three-white-line green ribbon.
Reproduces the official three-class material and ribbon-line distinctions for the Duty Medal.
